const bass_drum = s("bd:4")
  .beat("0, 10", 16)

const snare_drum = s("sd:3")
  .beat("4, 12", 16)

const high_hat_fast = s("white!3 ~ white!2 ~ white").bassenv()

// FX

const noiseFx = s("pink(<7>,16)")

const gameboyStartup = n("<[0 7@7 ~@8] [~] [~] [~]>")
  .scale("C6:major")
  .sound("pulse")
  .fade(0.6, 0, 1, 1)

// Verse 1A

// LEAD GUITAR ARRANGEMENT

$leadGuitar: arrange(
  [GAMEBOY_NOISE,  silence],
  [GAMEBOY_PAUSE,  silence],
  [INTRO,          leadGuitarIntro.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, INTRO)],
  [VERSE_1_CHORDS, leadGuitarVerse1Chords.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, VERSE_1_CHORDS)],
  [VERSE_1A,       leadGuitarVerse1A.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, VERSE_1A)],
  [VERSE_1B,       leadGuitarVerse1B.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, VERSE_1B)],
  [PRECHORUS_1,    leadGuitarPrechorus1.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, PRECHORUS_1)],
  [CHORUS_1,       leadGuitarChorus.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, CHORUS_1)],
  [VERSE_2A,       leadGuitarVerse2A.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, VERSE_2A)],
  [VERSE_2B,       leadGuitarVerse2B.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, VERSE_2B)],
  [PRECHORUS_2,    leadGuitarPrechorus2.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, PRECHORUS_2)],
  [CHORUS_2,       leadGuitarChorus2.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, CHORUS_2)],
  [GUITAR_SOLO,    leadGuitarSolo.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, GUITAR_SOLO)],
  [CHORUS_3,       leadGuitarLastChorus.fade(1, 1, LEAD_GUITAR, CHORUS_3)],
  [CHORUS_FADEOUT, leadGuitarLastChorus.fade(1, 0, LEAD_GUITAR, CHORUS_FADEOUT)],
  [END, silence]
).lpenv(3.5).lpf(2500).lpq(2).orbit(2)
._scope()

// HARMONY GUITAR ARRANGEMENT

$harmonyGuitar: arrange(
  [GAMEBOY_NOISE,  silence],
  [GAMEBOY_PAUSE,  silence],
  [INTRO,          silence],
  [VERSE_1_CHORDS, silence],
  [VERSE_1A,       harmonyGuitarVerse1A.fade(1, 1, HARMONY_GUITAR, VERSE_1A)],
  [VERSE_1B,       silence],
  [PRECHORUS_1,    harmonyGuitarPrechorus1.fade(1, 1, HARMONY_GUITAR, PRECHORUS_1)],
  [CHORUS_1,       silence],
  [VERSE_2A,       harmonyGuitarVerse2A.fade(1, 1, HARMONY_GUITAR, VERSE_2A)],
  [VERSE_2B,       silence],
  [PRECHORUS_2,    harmonyGuitarPrechorus1.fade(1, 1, HARMONY_GUITAR, PRECHORUS_2)],
  [CHORUS_2,       silence],
  [GUITAR_SOLO,    harmonyGuitarSolo.fade(1, 1, HARMONY_GUITAR, GUITAR_SOLO)],
  [CHORUS_3,       silence],
  [CHORUS_FADEOUT, silence],
  [END, silence]
).lpenv(3.5).lpf(2500).lpq(2).orbit(2)
._scope()

bass: arrange(
  [GAMEBOY_NOISE,  silence],

$noiseFx: arrange(
  [GAMEBOY_NOISE,  silence],

).bassenv()._scope()

  [1, gameboyStartup],
  [129, silence],
  [END, silence]
)._scope()
